as_told.title: UFOs at CERN and the Brookhaven Cosmotron
as_told.place_text: CERN, Switzerland; Brookhaven National Lab, New York

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that UFOs seem to show up, anecdotally, around high-voltage experiments and particle accelerators, the huge machines physicists use to smash tiny particles together. He doesn't name any particular lab or date. If true, it would hint that whatever is behind UFOs is drawn to our most powerful energy and physics work.
